<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

You compose a _heartening missive_ by creating a short message or image intended to grant the recipient moral support. You must dedicate the missive to an individual creature you know and address it to their location (typically the settlement where you think they are). Once you finish composing the missive, it folds itself into the shape of an animal and [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=94) at a speed of 45 feet (about 15 miles per hour) toward the location for up to 24 hours. It alights near the recipient or in their hand. After Activating the missive, the recipient gets its benefit and becomes temporarily immune to all _heartening missives_ for 24 hours.

 If the missive fails to reach its recipient in 24 hours, it returns to its sender at the same pace, becoming non-magical when it arrives. After imparting or losing its magic, the missive remains as a normal document.

Once you finish composing the missive, it folds itself into the shape of an animal and Flies at a speed of 45 feet (about 15 miles per hour) toward the location for up to 24 hours. It alights near the recipient or in their hand. After Activating the missive, the recipient gets its benefit and becomes temporarily immune to all heartening missives for 24 hours. If the missive fails to reach its recipient in 24 hours, it returns to its sender at the same pace, becoming non-magical when it arrives. After imparting or losing its magic, the missive remains as a normal document. Item 6 Heartening Missive (Bull) Source Treasure Vault pg. 85 Price 50 gp Folded into a bull, this missive grants the recipient a sense of solidity. The recipient gains a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves for the next 24 hours. Item 5 Heartening Missive (Butterfly) Source Treasure Vault pg. 85 Price 25 gp Folded into a delicate butterfly, this missive grants the recipient a sense of grace and poise. Once during the next 24 hours, when the recipient fails a Diplomacy or Performance check, they can improve the result from a failure to a success or from a critical failure to a failure. This is a fortune effect. Item 6 Heartening Missive (Rabbit) Source Treasure Vault pg. 85 Price 50 gp Folded into a rabbit sitting on its haunches, this missive grants the recipient a sense of mischief and agility. The recipient gains a +1 item bonus to Reflex saves for the next 24 hours. Item 6 Heartening Missive (Turtle) Source Treasure Vault pg. 85 Price 50 gp Folded into a square-shelled turtle, this missive grants the recipient a firm sense of self and serenity. The recipient gains a +1 item bonus to Will saves for the next 24 hours.

 If the missive fails to reach its recipient in 24 hours, it returns to its sender at the same pace, becoming non-magical when it arrives. After imparting or losing its magic, the missive remains as a normal document.

>
[Heartripper Blade](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1730)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Crown of the Kobold King</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Crown of the Kobold King](/Sources.aspx?ID=148) pg. 115

**Price** 160 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wicked-looking curved weapon is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_ that draws power from defeating foes, either to bolster itself or its wielder. A _heartripper blade_ is well suited for use in any ritual that involves divination, and incorporating it into any ritual with the [divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47) trait grants the wielder a +1 item bonus on any check made to resolve the effects of the ritual's casting.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a Strike from the _heartripper blade_;  **Effect** The _heartripper blade_ draws power from the devastating strike, causing its blade to erupt in black flames. For 1 minute, Strikes with the _heartripper blade_ inflict an additional 1d6 negative damage to living creatures.

This gemstone grants its wearer a +2 item bonus to saving throws.

Each _heartstone_ is powered by the spirit of a specific night hag. If it’s separated from her for 24 hours (or she’s been dead for 24 hours), it becomes a nonmagical gemstone. A _heartstone_ allows the hag to use additional occult innate spells: _[ethereal jaunt](/Spells.aspx?ID=105)_ (9th level) and _[bind soul](/Spells.aspx?ID=21)_ at will, and _[shadow blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=273)_ twice per day.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;    **Requirements** You must be touching the _heartstone_.; **Effect** The _heartstone_ attempts to counteract one disease affecting you (counteract level 5, counteract modifier +18).

**Craft Requirements** You must be a night hag.

This pale gemstone grants its wearer a +2 item bonus to saving throws and the ability to discern a target's alignment (as [_detect alignment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=65), but can detect chaotic, evil, good, and lawful auras simultaneously) at will by peering through the gemstone.

 Like all hag _heartstones_, this gemstone is powered by [Skarja's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2110) spirit. Skarja does not need to wear her _heartstone_ to benefit from its powers, but she cannot use them if she hasn't touched her _heartstone_ in the past 7 days. If Skarja's _heartstone_ is separated from her for more than 7 days (or if she's been dead for 7 days), it becomes a non-magical gemstone. Skarja's _heartstone_ allows her to use additional occult innate spells: [_ethereal jaunt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=105) (9th level) and [_bind soul_](/Spells.aspx?ID=21) at will, [_shadow blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=273) (6th level) twice per day, and [_spirit blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=301) once per day.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;    **Requirements** You must be touching the _heartstone_; **Effect** The _heartstone_ attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) one [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) affecting you (counteract level 7, counteract modifier +23).

This fine cloak is lined with tiny tubes of slowly reacting alchemical reagents. These chemicals generate heat, which is circulated throughout the cloak by the wearer's movements. </row>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +9; [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) vision 30 feet, [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) hearing 30 feet

**Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) (two common languages)

**Skills** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +9, one skill associated with their use +9

**Int** +2, **Wis** +2, **Cha** +2

**Will** +7 

</column>

---        

Tools that are severely misused or left in malevolent circumstances can develop malicious sapience, dedicated to critiquing those who use them. Such _heckling tools_ are often born from implements useful to adventurers because such people are the likely to misuse tools or leave them in a corrupting situation. When you first set to using the tools, they fuse to you. Used for their intended purpose, the tools telepathically badger and disparage you, mocking your abilities and giving you ill-founded advice. You must succeed at a DC 19 Will save to realize this badgering comes from the tools and not your own negative thoughts. Instead of the tool's usual bonus, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to checks made using _heckling tools_. Once you realize the tools are cursed, you can suppress their negative effects, gaining their typical bonus for 24 hours if you succeed at a DC 17 [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) or [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) check to placate them, often by offering obsequious, public admiration.

These wicked-looking spiked metal wheels fit around the ankles and jingle when the wearer walks, imposing a –1 item penalty on [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. If used as a weapon, they are treated as a [spiked gauntlet](/Weapons.aspx?ID=11).

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 132 **Price** 13,000 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- A _hell staff_ is a tall, pointed staff forged of red-tinted steel with [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117) inscriptions that march neatly down its sides. At its top sits an inverted ruby pyramid divided into nine sections. Found mostly in Cheliax or other lands where diabolic influences hold sway, when used as a weapon the staff is a _[+3 greater striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [flaming ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2838) [unholy ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2851) [staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=367)_. When you prepare this staff, if you’re [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), you become [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 1 until your next daily preparations. The staff’s [_summon lesser servitor_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2034) spell can be used only to summon animals with the [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600) trait, [devils](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=389), or [hell hounds](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=427) (at 4th rank). Its [_summon fiend_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1701) spell can summon only devils or hell hounds. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
  • **Cantrip** [_divine lance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1498)
  • **1st** [_protection_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1641), _summon lesser servitor_
  • **2nd** [darkvision](/Familiars.aspx?ID=142), _summon lesser servitor_
  • **3rd** [_chilling darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1464), _darkvision_, _summon lesser servitor_
  • **4th** [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1499), _summon lesser servitor_
  • **5th** _darkvision_, [_divine immolation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1496), _summon fiend_
  • **6th** [_devil form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=894), _summon fiend_
  • **7th** [_divine decree_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1495), _summon fiend_
**Craft Requirements** You’re unholy. Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

    right="Item 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Hellhusk Shroud](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4180)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Hellbreakers</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers](/Sources.aspx?ID=307) pg. 211

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This hooded cloak is popular among those who must evade or surveil fiendish authorities. The grisly secrets behind this garment belies its innocuous appearance; its fabrics include threads woven from the hair, blood, and scales of various devils. When invested, a _hellhusk shroud_ doesn't appear to radiate a magic aura to [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485) or similar spells unless the spells are 4th rank or higher. As long as you're wearing the cloak, you can read and speak [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117).

**Activate—Horned Husk** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The cloak wraps around you, becoming a second skin that suffuses you with Hell's corrosive brimstone. Your appearance becomes that of a nondescript low-level devil, and you gain a +1 status bonus to your Deception checks when you [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=2389) to maintain your disguise. To creatures with [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74), you also smell like a devil.

**Activate—Hellish Senses** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pull your hood up, allowing the remnants of fallen devils to nestle closely and whisper Hell's secrets. You gain fiendsense as an imprecise sense within 60 feet, allowing you to sense creatures with the fiend trait as a [vague sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=2408). This effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you take this action again

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This [standard-grade duskwood](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2815) [meteor shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=13) (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is a wheel from a ship. While wielding the shield, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Sailing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) and to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;  **Requirements** You're in a body of water; **Effect** For 10 minutes, you don't sink if you haven't succeeded at a Swim action on a turn, and if you're submerged, you automatically ascend 10 feet at the end of your turn.

May contain spoilers from Curtain Call **Source** [Pathfinder #204: Stage Fright](/Sources.aspx?ID=245) pg. 80 **Price** 3,000 gp **Usage** worn --- Adorned with golden herald horns, this green ring both enhances a performer’s vocal projection and provides partial protection against sonic attacks. **Activate—Project Voice** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** When you turn the _herald’s ring_ around your finger three times in either direction, you gain the ability to easily project your voice up to 200 feet without raising the volume of speech, reaching your audience in most venues, including arenas. This effect lasts up to 2 hours. **Activate—Reflect Sound** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You take [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697) damage from a spell or effect; **Effect** You use the _herald’s ring_ to reflect a portion of the sonic damage back at its source by attempting to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the effect. The ring has a counteract modifier of +23. **Critical Success** All of the damage is reflected back on its source.
**Success** Half of the damage is reflected back at its source, and the other half is negated.
**Failure** Half of the damage is reflected back at the source, and you take the rest of the damage.
**Critical Failure** None of the damage is reflected, but the _herald’s ring_ does absorb enough energy so that you can activate it again today.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Teleportation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=156" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 154, [Pathfinder #169: Kindled Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=94) pg. 73

**Price** 210 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

All _herd masks_ are linked to at least one other _herd mask_ and are usually sold in sets of multiple masks. Linked _herd masks_ look like one another, with only the slightest of differences to tell them apart.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You swap locations with another creature wearing a linked _herd mask_ within 100 feet. If you and the creature you swapped with are disguised as each other, other creatures gain an immediate Perception check against the lower of your or the other wearer's [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) DCs to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) each other. On a failure, they don't realize the swap occurred.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_translocate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724). You can link a _herd mask_ you create to another _herd mask_ in your possession when you finish crafting it, which causes it to be linked to the chosen mask as well as all other _herd masks_ that are also linked to the chosen mask.

</column>

May contain spoilers from Outlaws of Alkenstar **Source** [Pathfinder #180: The Smoking Gun](/Sources.aspx?ID=125) pg. 73 **Price** 1,400 gp **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** 2 **Base Weapon** [Arquebus](/Weapons.aspx?ID=195) --- This _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [fearsome](/Equipment.aspx?ID=731) [arquebus](/Weapons.aspx?ID=195)_ is composed of warped and twisted wood engraved with eerie runes. When the weapon fires, the blast sometimes sounds like the cackling of a diabolical witch. **Activate** command; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You afflict a creature you can see with a hex of _impending doom_. The hex lasts for 1 minute. As long as the creature is hexed, when you hit it with a round from the hex blaster, the creature must attempt a DC 28 Will save at the end of your turn; the creature attempts a single Will save regardless of the number of times you hit it. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19). It also takes 1d6 [persistent mental damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
**Failure** The creature is frightened 2. It also takes 2d6 persistent mental damage.
**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 2 and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) for 1 minute. It also takes 4d6 persistent mental damage and is cursed with a hex of _impending doom_. If the target falls [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) from damage dealt by this Strike or the persistent mental damage, it remains unconscious for 1 day or until this curse is removed. After 1 day, if the creature is still unconscious, it must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save or die; this effect has the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) and [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93) traits.

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Dangling from a simple cord, a _hexing jar_ houses rich soil. When a [witch](/Classes.aspx?ID=16) who has invested the jar wears it overnight, a miniature thing grows from the soil. Your patron chooses the form, commonly including glowing mushrooms, venus flytraps, mandragora roots, or undead hands reaching up. The thing whispers secrets it learned from your patron, giving you a +2 item bonus to your patron skill.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a witch [hex](/Traits.aspx?ID=324) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You roll a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or your target rolls a critical failure on its saving throw against a witch spell or hex you cast;  **Effect** The thing in the jar becomes more energetic—glowing, dancing, rapping on the glass, or some other action appropriate to its appearance. It encourages you until the start of your next turn, granting you and your familiar a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects.

**Craft Requirements** You are a witch.

</column>

>
[High-Contrast Goggles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3248)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 113

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Made with a brightly colored leather strap, these goggles have a series of overlapping lenses in an array of colors spanning the spectrum of visible light. The effect of this is that every color is more vibrant and similar shades have higher contrast. This means that shapes of even similar colors tend to stand out more, allowing the wearer to see even camouflage easier.

As an [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) action, you can set the lenses to make things stand out at your current location. Until you move, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks when you [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301).

</column>

May contain spoilers from Dead God's Hand **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 142 --- Throneglass is an incredibly rare resource created during the violence of Earthfall 10,000 years ago, when the impact of falling stars enhanced certain shattered panes of green glass built into the architecture of important buildings in Azlant— particularly the Imperial Palace. As a material, throneglass is as strong as steel, but the ancient methods of crafting it into weapons have long been lost. Low-grade throneglass offers no additional benefit to a weapon crafted from it other than the cosmetic and intrinsic value of the precious material, but standard-grade and high-grade throneglass can retain psychic power and then release it through a strike. When a creature wielding a standard-grade or high-grade throneglass weapon succeeds at a saving throw against a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effect, the weapon stores some of that energy and holds it for a future attack. A standard-grade weapon can hold this energy for 1 round before it dissipates harmlessly, while a high-grade one can hold the energy for 1 minute. The next time you [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) a creature with a throneglass weapon with stored energy, the creature struck must attempt a Will save (DC 24 for standardgrade throneglass, or DC 35 for high-grade throneglass) to avoid becoming [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 round (or stupefied 2 on a critical failure). ## Throneglass Items

---

Not to be outdone by their cousins in Dongun Hold, the artificers of Highhelm have developed a handheld magical equivalent to their clockwork drilling constructs and vehicles. The device is still in the testing phases, but early versions have been released to fund more development. Appearing as an unassuming yellow box with two handles normally, when the command word is spoken, a spiraling drill made of force emerges from its top. An active _Highhelm drill_ can be used as an [improvised weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=224), dealing damage on a Strike as though it had been used on a surface for one round with no additional damage from other sources.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The force drill appears and begins turning, dealing 5 force damage per round to any material against which you hold the drill. The drill ignores the first 4 Hardness of any material it damages. The drill remains active for 1 minute.

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Highhelm Stronghold Plate](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2567)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 112

**Price** 3,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 5
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Bastion Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=17)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+2 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [fortification](/Equipment.aspx?ID=285) [bastion plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=17)_ is made almost entirely of stone plates. It looks almost unwearable and is in fact only wearable because of numerous minor enchantments for comfort and mobility. If you have [armor specialization](/Rules.aspx?ID=211) with heavy armor, your resistance while wearing _Highhelm stronghold plate_ applies to both slashing and piercing damage.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The plating on your armor explodes off of your body, expands, and reshapes, transforming into a stone structure with the effects of [_wall of stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=365). While the armor is transformed in this way, you don't gain the benefits of wearing the armor. The armor remains transformed for up to 10 minutes or until you Dismiss the effect, at which point the wall of stone disappears and the armor returns to you, donning itself immediately.

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of _wall of stone_.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 112

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Razor Disc](/Shields.aspx?ID=14)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This specialized [razor disc](/Shields.aspx?ID=14) (Hardness 11, HP 84, BT 42) was originally designed by the members of Clan Molgrade for use by Highhelm's soldiers. The integrated blades are etched with runes, making them a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280)_ weapon.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You critically hit with the shield's integrated blades;  **Effect** The shield's blades grow and dig themselves into your foe. The creature becomes [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) as it becomes impaled on the shield spikes. While you have a creature grabbed in this way, you can't [Raise the Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98), but the creature takes [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) every round equal to the number of damage dice. This persistent bleed can't end as long as the creature is impaled on the shield. You can Release the shield to leave it embedded in the creature. This ends the grab but doesn't end the persistent bleed damage. The creature can remove the shield and end the grab by attempting a check to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79). This normally uses your [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) DC to Escape, but if you're no longer holding the shield, the Escape DC is 25.

</column>

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

---

This bottle is packed with dirt, though the shrunken corpse of an [ankhrav hive mother](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2823) is buried within. When you open the bottle, the effigy of a Huge ankhrav hive mother emerges, burrows up to 20 feet, and then erupts from the ground spraying acid, creating a 15-foot-by-15-foot pit that’s 10 feet deep. Creatures standing in this area take 6d6 acid damage and 1d6 [persistent acid damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) (DC 24 basic Reflex save). A success or critical success means the creature also leaps to safety, landing in the nearest space adjacent to the pit. A failure or critical failure means the creature falls into the pit. Climbing out of the pit requires a successful DC 22 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check.

**Craft Requirements** Supply the corpse of an [ankhrav hive mother](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2823).

>
[Hoax-Hunter's Kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1616)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 63

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 2

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wooden box unfolds into a stack of hinged trays holding calipers, magnifying lenses, acids and reagents, comparison sketches of species commonly mistaken for one another, and glass slides for specimen testing. When you use this kit to study accounts of a creature or what it left behind (such as spoor, tracks, or fur samples), you gain a +1 item bonus to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the creature or to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) the creature. In addition, if you fail to Recall Knowledge about the creature (but don't critically fail), you're able to eliminate at least one possibility of a common type of animal. For instance, you might be able to verify the creature isn't an [owlbear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=328), even if you get no further information.

---

Dyed green and white and studded with the natural spines of a hodag, this _[+1](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2785) [deathless](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1238) [studded leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=42)_ is an imposing sight, especially when its wearer is barreling towards you.

**Activate—Hodag Toss** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to your Speed and make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) at the end of your movement. If you succeed at your Strike, attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check against the creature’s Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature is thrown 10 feet in a straight line in the direction of your choice and lands [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88). If the creature is knocked into a solid object, it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage before landing prone. You can instead toss the creature straight up into the air. The creature lands in the same square it occupied, and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage as it lands prone. You can’t use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the hide of a [hodag](/Monsters.aspx?ID=701).

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Revenge of the Runelords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star](/Sources.aspx?ID=283) pg. 70

**Price** 300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These heavy cloth garments function as a set of +2 _[resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2786) [ explorer’s clothing](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2715)_. They feature multiple stylish layers, voluminous sleeves, and long strings of Thassilonian runes along the hems. The robes employ potent illusion magic, sufficient to convince the wearer and any attackers that a devastating blow is nothing more than a flesh wound. 

**Activate—Empty Robes** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The wearer becomes invisible inside the robes for one minute. Since the wearer’s gear (including the robes) remain visible, they don’t become concealed, but they can’t be visually identified unless the viewer can see invisible creatures. **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 601 **Price** 4,500 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 **Base Weapon** [Longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31) --- The gleaming _holy avenger_ is the iconic weapon of powerful [paladins](/Causes.aspx?ID=1). The crossbar of this _+2 greater striking [holy](/Equipment.aspx?ID=299) [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31)_ is styled to look like angel wings. Tradition holds that those who see their reflection in a _holy avenger's_ highly polished blade have their faults laid bare. If you are evil, you are [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) while carrying or wielding this weapon. **Activate** command, Interact; **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You command the sword and point it at a creature you can see. The sword casts [_detect alignment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=65) to detect evil, but this targets only the selected creature instead of detecting in an area. **Paladin Wielder** If you're a [champion](/Classes.aspx?ID=4) of the paladin cause, you also gain the following two benefits.
  • When you critically hit an evil creature with the _holy avenger_, the creature is [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) and enfeebled 2 for 1 round.
  • You can activate the sword in the following way. **Activate** command; **Frequency** once per day; **Requirements** You hit a creature using the _holy avenger_ on your previous action; **Effect** You cast [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) at the same level as your champion focus spells. It must target an illusion the creature you hit created, a spell affecting the creature you hit, or an item the creature you hit wears or carries. The spell or item you attempt to counteract must be within 120 feet of you.
**Craft Requirements** You are a champion with the paladin cause; supply a casting of _detect alignment_ and _dispel magic_. The initial raw materials must include 120 gp of cold iron.

---

This strand of ordinary-looking prayer beads glows with a soft light and becomes warm to the touch the first time you cast a divine spell while holding it. When you do, the prayer beads become attuned to your deity, changing their form and iconography to prominently incorporate your deity’s religious symbol and iconography. The beads don’t transform or function for an evil spellcaster.

 Whenever you cast a divine spell from your own spell slots while holding the prayer beads, you recover 1 Hit Point; this is a positive healing effect. If the spell you cast was a healing spell, you can grant this additional healing to one of the spell’s targets instead of yourself.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;     **Effect** Cast [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25) or [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), each once per day.

**Craft Requirements** You have a spellcasting class feature with the divine tradition.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Holy Steam Ball](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1150)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 87

**Price** 30 gp (2 gp per refill)

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _holy steam ball_ is an odd-looking device that's nevertheless effective at reinforcing its user's mind against fiendish control. It's a hollow black-rubber ball with small, flexible twin tubes sticking out from its center. Sealed within the rubber ball is vapor made from a mixture of evaporated _[holy water](/Equipment.aspx?ID=245)_ and a special type of incense smoke. The tube's twin prongs are placed into the user's nostrils, after which the user squeezes the rubber ball to activate the device, forcing the vapor into the user's body through their nose. The holy power contained within the vapor strengthens the user's will against creatures that are weak to _holy water_, making it tougher for malevolent creatures to subvert the user's mind.

 When the _holy steam ball_ was first introduced in Mendev fifty years ago, few trusted it's efficacy. The nation had seen many charlatans peddle so-called “anti-[demon](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=28)” products, and most thought this was no different. Only when soldiers of the Mendevian Crusades used the ball and personally testified to its effectiveness did suspicion gave way to enthusiastic use. Nobody remembers who first invented the _holy steam ball_; they're likely lost to history because most initially thought it was a scam. After receiving endorsement from the Mendevian Crusade, a team of alchemists and inventors were able to determine the vapor's exact composition and mass produce them. The _holy steam ball's_ highly specialized purpose kept it from widespread use outside of the nations that once bordered the Worldwound. Yet with the return of the Whispering Tyrant in the past few years, the growing [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) threat presents a new opportunity for more citizens to use _holy steam balls_ for protection against the mind control powers of vampires and other undead.

 After using a _holy steam ball_, you must refill it before the next use in a process that takes five minutes to complete.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _holy steam ball_ is filled with evaporated _holy water_ and incense smoke; **Effect** You release the stored steam and smoke to grant yourself its protections. Each use of the _holy steam ball_ lasts for 1 hour and gives you a +2 item bonus to Will saving throws against possession effects from [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=70) and undead and effects from fiends and undead that cause the [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) condition.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This small tattoo of a swallow always points toward your home. The tattooing must take place at a location you consider to be your home, or the magic fails to bind with the ink. When you travel to your home using [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710) that can be off target, such as [_teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1720) or [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576), you arrive exactly at your home. If your home is destroyed or you come to believe a new place is your home, this tattoo fades from your skin.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** You sense the direction toward your home.

</row>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinders have access._

**Price** 28 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A _wayfinder_ functions as a compass.

 An indentation in the middle of the _wayfinder_ can hold a single _aeon stone_. Placing an _aeon stone_ in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the _aeon stone_ orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a _wayfinder_ and the _aeon stone_ within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested _aeon stone_ slotted in a _wayfinder_ also grants its resonant power.

 If you have more than one _wayfinder_ with an invested _aeon stone_ on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, just not in _wayfinders_.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** The _wayfinder_ is targeted by a 1st-level [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=171) spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Archaic Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=6) pg. 17

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder_

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>Cast a Spell</row></row>

</column>

---

An _archaic wayfinder_ functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an _archaic wayfinder_, a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an _archaic wayfinder_ is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An _archaic wayfinder_ can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An _archaic wayfinder_ counts against the limit of one _wayfinder_ with a slotted resonant _[aeon stone](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407)_.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Limited"
>
Wayfinder of Rescue
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave](/Sources.aspx?ID=9) pg. 42

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

As a standard _wayfinder_, but once per day you can activate it to cast _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ as a 1st-level spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bi-Resonant Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 110

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of _aeon stones_. A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ works just like a regular _wayfinder_ except it has two _aeon stone_ slots, and the _aeon stones_ in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The _bi-resonant wayfinder_ and the two _aeon stones_ count as two items toward your investiture limit.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Shining Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 111

**Price** 100 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _shining wayfinder_ is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_, except instead of an activation to cast _light_, the shining wayfinder has the following two activations.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You hold the _wayfinder_ and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) on you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs="Standard"
>
Vanishing Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 112

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _vanishing wayfinder_ is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_ and the following additional activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You turn the _wayfinder_ in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) spell for 5 minutes.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Limited"
>
Chronicler Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 30

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction._

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

_Chronicler wayfinders_ bear a mystical connection to the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each _chronicler wayfinder_ is attuned to a specific [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You tap into the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ on the _chronicler wayfinder's_ attuned topic, gaining the effects of a [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Limited"
>
Razmiri Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 72

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

Worn on a chain around the neck, a _Razmiri wayfinder_ functions as a [compass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=16) and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) or [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46). _Razmiri wayfinders_ can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** three times per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> manipulate;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against one [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Air)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 650 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you can cast [_feather fall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=111) as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Earth)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you dig twice as quickly as normal.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_stoneskin_](/Spells.aspx?ID=312).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Fire)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain resistance 5 to fire.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=119).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Water)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain the constant effects of [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=370).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_hydraulic torrent_](/Spells.aspx?ID=155).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Fashionable Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

_Fashionable wayfinders_ allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _fashionable wayfinder_ can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A _fashionable wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 13"
pfs="Standard"
>
Homeward Wayfinder
</title>

---

_Homeward wayfinders_ are powerful escape tools in the hands of a Pathfinder agent, drawing upon a special connection to the Maze of the Open Road. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _homeward wayfinder_ attunes itself to the most recent Pathfinder Lodge you've visited and has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (command, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You teleport back to the attuned Pathfinder Lodge, as long as you are no more than 100 miles away. This [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156) effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an [extradimensional](/Traits.aspx?ID=67) space.

---

_Hummingbird wayfinders_ blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original _wayfinder_ design, allowing the _wayfinder_ to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _hummingbird wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cause the _wayfinder_ to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the _wayfinder_ being a visible bird, this has the effects of [_prying eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=239). In addition to [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) through the hummingbird, you can activate any [_aeon stone_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407) within the _wayfinder_ as if the _wayfinder_ were still on your person. When the effect ends, the _wayfinder_ transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the _wayfinder_.

fields.text: Item 2+ Wayfinder Source Core Rulebook pg. 617 This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones . It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. Item 2 Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source Core Rulebook pg. 617 PFS Note All Pathfinders have access. Price 28 gp Usage worn This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones . It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A wayfinder functions as a compass. An indentation in the middle of the wayfinder can hold a single aeon stone . Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a wayfinder and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested aeon stone slotted in a wayfinder also grants its resonant power. If you have more than one wayfinder with an invested aeon stone on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not in wayfinders . Activate Single Action command; Effect The wayfinder is targeted by a 1st-level light spell. Item 2 Archaic Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source World Guide pg. 17 PFS Note All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder Price 30 gp Usage held in 1 hand Activate Cast a Spell An archaic wayfinder functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an archaic wayfinder , a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an archaic wayfinder is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An archaic wayfinder can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An archaic wayfinder counts against the limit of one wayfinder with a slotted resonant aeon stone . Item 4 Wayfinder of Rescue Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave pg. 42 Price 80 gp Usage worn As a standard wayfinder , but once per day you can activate it to cast heal on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of heal as a 1st-level spell. Item 6 Bi-Resonant Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 110 Price 200 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A bi-resonant wayfinder is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of aeon stones . A bi-resonant wayfinder works just like a regular wayfinder except it has two aeon stone slots, and the aeon stones in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The bi-resonant wayfinder and the two aeon stones count as two items toward your investiture limit. Item 4 Shining Wayfinder Uncommon Abjuration Divination Evocation Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 111 Price 100 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A shining wayfinder is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder , except instead of an activation to cast light , the shining wayfinder has the following two activations. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Effect You hold the wayfinder and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts guidance on you. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts bless , with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet. Item 5 Vanishing Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 112 Price 150 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A vanishing wayfinder is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder and the following additional activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You turn the wayfinder in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level invisibility spell for 5 minutes. Item 6 Chronicler Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 30 PFS Note Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction. Price 200 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Chronicler wayfinders bear a mystical connection to the Pathfinder Chronicles themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each chronicler wayfinder is attuned to a specific Lore skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You tap into the Pathfinder Chronicles on the chronicler wayfinder's attuned topic, gaining the effects of a Recall Knowledge action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill. Item 10 Razmiri Wayfinder Uncommon Illusion Magical Necromancy Source PFS Guide pg. 72 Price 900 gp Usage worn Worn on a chain around the neck, a Razmiri wayfinder functions as a compass and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Impersonate. Razmiri wayfinders can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster. Activate Single Action envision; Frequency three times per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour. Activate Single Action manipulate; Frequency once per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends. Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Air) Uncommon Air Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 650 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you can cast feather fall as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level lightning bolt . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Earth) Uncommon Earth Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 600 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you dig twice as quickly as normal. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level stoneskin . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Fire) Uncommon Evocation Fire Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 700 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain resistance 5 to fire. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level fireball . Item 10 Elemental Wayfinder (Water) Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Water Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 900 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain the constant effects of water breathing . Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level hydraulic torrent . Item 3 Fashionable Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 50 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Fashionable wayfinders allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a fashionable wayfinder can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A fashionable wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing. Item 13 Homeward Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Evocation Invested Magical Teleportation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 2,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. This teleportation effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional space. Item 12 Hummingbird Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Transmutation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 1,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Hummingbird wayfinders blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original wayfinder design, allowing the wayfinder to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a hummingbird wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per hour; Effect You cause the wayfinder to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the wayfinder being a visible bird, this has the effects of prying eye . In addition to Seeking through the hummingbird, you can activate any aeon stone within the wayfinder as if the wayfinder were still on your person. When the effect ends, the wayfinder transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the wayfinder .

This sweet-scented poison triggers vivid hallucinations in those who succumb to it, causing most to believe swarms of ravenous biting insects are feeding on them. So vivid are these hallucinations that the victims damage themselves by scratching and clawing at the imaginary swarm. At the GM's discretion, a creature incapable of clawing at itself might instead slam against solid objects, in which case the poison inflicts bludgeoning damage.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Given as thanks for honoring the memories of three unfortunate travelers who met a tragic end in the Willowshore Hinterlands, this red-hooded cloak is decorated with an image of an elaborately dressed performer whose two companions hold a lantern and umbrella for her.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet) like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60). For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the lantern activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the umbrella.

</column>

Activate—Release Lantern Three Actions (concentrate, light, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Requirements You don’t have the Release Umbrella activation of this cloak active; Effect With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm’s length while casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) like a torch. For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. You can Release Lantern again to dismiss the effect. Activate—Release Umbrella Three Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Requirements You don’t have the Release Lantern activation of this cloak active; Effect With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to Survival checks. You can Release Umbrella again to dismiss the effect.

May contain spoilers from Quest for the Frozen Flame **Source** [Pathfinder #175: Broken Tusk Moon](/Sources.aspx?ID=112) pg. 79 **Price** 10 gp --- This snare consists of several narrow, sharpened stakes, each over a foot long, clustered together and pointing upward. The snare is patently obvious unless planted amid tall reeds or grasses or in someplace dark. Medium and smaller creatures can pass among the stakes easily; unlike most snares, the hoof stakes snare triggers only when a Large or larger creature enters its square. The snare deals 2d6 piercing damage to the triggering creature, which must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature takes half damage, and it takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for 1 minute, or until the creature or an ally spends three Interact actions to carefully remove the stakes.
**Failure** The triggering creature takes full damage. The creature takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed, and any time it deals damage with a foot Strike (including as part of [Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=39) or a similar ability), the creature takes 2d6 piercing damage. The effect lasts for 1 minute, or until the creature or an ally spends three Interact actions to carefully remove the stakes.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the circumstance penalty to its Speed is –10 feet, and the creature takes 4d6 damage whenever it deals damage with a foot Strike.

A _horn of exorcism_ is an instrument made from an animal horn, or an object of the same shape from carved wood or ivory. 

**Activate—Rattle the Dead** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Blowing into the horn frightens ghosts and evil spirits who can hear its call. Make an Intimidation check to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) against all creatures with the undead or unholy trait in a 30-foot emanation. This can affect even a mindless creature with that trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. 

**Activate—Sacred Seeds** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You fill the horn with sacred seeds and then scatter them around you with a twist of your wrist. The horn grants you and your allies in a 30-foot emanation the [ghost touch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune on all of your weapon and unarmed Strikes for 1 minute.
